Local Ambassador Program

National Ambassadors

Meet the Local Ambassadors leading the Global Reasoning Challenge community in their countries and recognitions earned at each program level.

Recognition

Ambassador levels

Ambassadors are recognized publicly as they grow their local community, from Newcomer through Honoured.

Newcomer Experienced Accomplished Distinguished Honoured
Featured ambassadors

This year’s national ambassadors

Ananya S. — India

Honoured · Leading India’s community since 2022, with 90+ participating schools.

Camila R. — Brazil

Distinguished · Built a network of 40+ schools across five states.

Jonas W. — Germany

Accomplished · Runs regional workshops ahead of the Qualification Round.

Diego M. — Mexico

Experienced · Coordinates translation and outreach for Spanish-speaking students.

Mikaela T. — Philippines

Experienced · Partners with local STEM clubs to recruit new schools.

Brian O. — Kenya

Newcomer · Onboarded 12 schools in his first season as ambassador.

Want to see the ambassador for a specific country? Search by country → or apply to become one yourself →
